14 жовтня 2026

Automation Specialist (Make, n8n, Python)

віддалено

Join us on a part-time basis to build cutting-edge automation systems for commercial clients. You will analyze business processes, leverage the best of Low-code, Python, and AI, and own end-to-end workflow solutions that save hundreds of hours of manual work.

A new team member will be in charge of

  • Analyzing clients’ business processes, gathering requirements, and proposing automation solutions
  • Building and optimizing automation workflows using Make, n8n, Zapier, and CogniAgent
  • Developing reliable API and webhook-based integrations between CRMs, ERPs, and marketing platforms
  • Writing Python scripts for complex custom automation logic when standard low-code features are insufficient
  • Working with databases like PostgreSQL or MySQL, writing SQL queries, and ensuring data synchronization
  • Monitoring, troubleshooting, and scaling existing automations to ensure stability

Does this relate to you?

  • 3+ years of experience in business process automation and workflow design
  • Experience with AI-powered automation tools
  • Strong expertise with Make, n8n, or Zapier
  • Medium Python knowledge for data manipulation and solid SQL skills
  • Deep understanding of APIs, Webhooks, JSON, and data management principles
  • Strong analytical thinking and ability to communicate technical solutions to clients directly
  • English at an Upper-Intermediate level or higher for direct communication

Ready to try your hand? Send your CV without a doubt!
